intro: Waterloo Region mixes student favourites with some genuinely special restaurants in Uptown Waterloo and Downtown Kitchener.

picks.name: Bhima's Warung
picks.why: Indonesian-inspired fusion that's been a local special-occasion favourite for years.

picks.name: Kinkaku Izakaya
picks.why: Japanese izakaya with sushi and small plates — good for lingering over a long dinner.

picks.name: Lion Brewery Restaurant
picks.why: Pub food in the historic Huether Hotel building, with a brewery history going back to the 1800s.

picks.name: Ennio's Pasta House
picks.why: Family-run Italian with homestyle pastas. Comforting and consistent.

picks.name: Lancaster Smokehouse
picks.why: Southern-style smoked meats and ribs in a laid-back setting.

picks.name: Kabob Hut
picks.why: Persian kabobs and saffron rice at student-friendly prices.

picks.name: Mozy's Shawarma
picks.why: A student-town shawarma favourite for a cheap, filling dinner.
